buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Generic Malicious Code Certificate: The seller should upload following certificate in the bid:- (a) This is to certify that the Hardware and the Software being offered, as part of the contract, does not contain Embedded Malicious code that would activate procedures to :- (i) Inhibit the desires and designed function of the equipment. (ii) Cause physical damage to the user or equipment during the exploitation. (iii) Tap information resident or transient in the equipment/network. (b) The firm will be considered to be in breach of the procurement contract, in case physical damage, loss of information or infringements related to copyright and Intellectual Property Right (IPRs) are caused due to activation of any such malicious code in embedded software. 4. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 5. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Notarized Affidavit on rupees 500 e -stamp paper stating that the Bidder is not under liquidation

and blacklisted by any state govt/central govt. (Notarized Affidavit date should be after bid published, duly signed stamp and Notary). 2. Bidder must submit the following certificates: Copy of PAN Card. Copy of GSTIN. Copy of Cancelled Cheque, Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank, shop act & MSME Certificate . 3. Bidder must submit the SELF ATTESTED 12 MONTH GST REPORT, SELF ATTESTED UPTO DATE and ITR fo r last three financial years (i.e. Financial Year-2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). 4. The bidder must have ISO 9001, ISO 14001,ISO 21015 , ISO 21016, ISO 24496, ISO 10002, SEDEX, BIFM A, IGBC, GREENGUARD, AIOTA, OHSAS 18001, ISO 13485, SEFA 10M , CE CERTIFICATE , ISO 50001, ISO 10 001 and ISO 27001 certification a copy of the same to be attached and also send verification link to verify t he certificate otherwise offer is rejected. 5. The Bidder will be provide zed Pledge certificate. 6. Bidder shall submit Signed and stamped copies of following mandatory tender documents along with their offer, failing to which the bid will be considered to be non-responsive and will be rejected 7. Bidder should have a registered office in MP region ( document copy required ). 8. Bidder Registered Address (Geographic location) & Bidder Service Centre Details 9. Emd exemption are not allowed in any condition and Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the D D along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid O pening and without receiving the hard copy of EMD and will be reject . 10. The Firm has to submit an undertaking that all terms & conditions are acceptable to the firm 11. Free delivery at site including loading /unloading. In respect of items requiring installation and or com missioning and other service in the scope of supply and the cost of the same is also included in contract pri ce 12. Product Warranty 1 Year undertaking will be provided undertaking to be submitted. 13. Delivery of Good should be completed within 15 days, self affidavit to be submitted 14. The bidder or registered MPGST Compulsory 15. Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in t he Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 16. For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid pro of for meeting the experience criteria: a. Purchase Order copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification b y the bidder that supplies against the invoices have been executed. b. Execution certificate by client with o rder value. c. Any other document in support of order execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc. 17. The Bidder Shall Furnish An Affidavit On Stamp Paper Duly Notarized Having Value Of Inr 500 To The E ffect That The Correct Information Has Been Furnished In The Tender And The Bidder Shall Be Solely Respo nsible For Furnishing Wrong/False Infromation In The Bid. The Bid Will Be Rejected Without This Document. After Award Of Contract The Consignee Will Give The Location To The Bidder Where The Product Will Be Su pply. 18. All Item Should Be Superior Quality 19. Experience Criteria: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / P SU / Public Listed Company for 3 years before the bid opening date. Copies of relevant contracts to be sub mitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity during each of the year. In case of bunch bids, the primary product having highest value should meet this criterion. 20. Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proc

eedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 21. Bidder should be submitted sample along with offer before 5 days of end date for quality check and pr oduct assurance. Bidders also collect the letter who fail to comply with this clause will be disqualified from further evaluation. 22. Data- Sheet / Catalogue Of The Product Offered In The Bid Are To Be Uploaded Along With Bid Docume nts. Buyers Can Match And Verify Data Sheet / Catalogue With The Product Specification Offered. In Case O f Any Un Explained Mis-Match Of Technical Parameters, The Bid Is Liable For Rejection 23. Bidder should be submitted undertaking of Land border clause and non deviations clause on specific fo rmat . 24. Any updating or correction to be published online only Please read all term and conditions carefully. 25. The Officer will have full right to accept, reject and cancel the tender without assigning any reason. 26. Undertaking Should be Given on letter head (format prescribed in Annexure II) that the product /items supplied against this tender by the Bidder is Made in India and up to 100 % of Raw material produced withi n India .
